newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya bandits stop 50 vehicles, shoot up bus.
newsitem.headline: Kenya bandits stop 50 vehicles, shoot up bus.

text.p: A gang of about 40 bandits robbed scores of vehicles on the main Nairobi-Mombasa road, killing one person and wounding seven when they shot up a crowded bus, the Sunday Nation reported.
Quoting witnesses at the scene, 250 km (150 miles) east of Nairobi, the newspaper said 50 cars and trucks were robbed on Friday night by bandits wearing military uniforms.
They killed the conductor of the bus and wounded seven passengers, the newspaper said.
The driver ignored orders to stop although bullets had punctured three tyres and drove 20 km (12 miles) to the nearest town, Mtito Andei, to inform police. There were 20 bullet-holes in the bus.
